Highball is included in Cosmos from https://github.com/gauthierpiarrette/highball

Commit: bbada878d142521a3267f0818a09cd62111b5789
Date: 2026-10-23
License: GPL-3.0 (LICENSE in this directory). Copyright remains with the Highball authors.

This tree is the upstream project, not a rewrite. Build it on macOS 14 or later
from this directory:

  swift build -c release

The CLI is .build/release/highball. The app target is HighballApp.
Recipes and the compatibility database are the sibling checkout
../highball-db (CC0 curated recipes/data, ODbL-1.0 db/derived predictions,
and MIT-derived anti-cheat data with its separate notice). See docs/HIGHBALL.md
in the Cosmos repository root.

Apple's Game Porting Toolkit license text is not in this copy. spike/d3dmetal-license.txt
was omitted. Highball already falls back to telling you to read License.pdf from
https://github.com/Gcenx/game-porting-toolkit before accepting D3DMetal. Cosmos does
not redistribute Apple's binaries or that license document.
